description: This Java source file defines a configuration class for Fineract that enables Liquibase-only mode. It uses Spring annotations for configuration, dependency injection, and conditional bean registration. The class logs a warning upon initialization indicating that Fineract is running in Liquibase-only mode.

classes.name: FineractLiquibaseOnlyApplicationConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that activates Liquibase-only mode for Fineract when certain conditions are met. It implements InitializingBean to log a warning during startup.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Logs a warning message indicating that Fineract is running in Liquibase-only mode. Called after all properties are set during Spring bean initialization.

calls: org.slf4j.Logger.warn("Fineract is running in Liquibase only mode")
